headline: The shelf reads dry — and the factory asks what to build next
lede: Contra S4 co-op is in build on slot b. Slot a ran the full ladder to an honest none: every gap on the shelf is shipped, owned, or now marked decided. The last unowned gap — FloorBoss's cart body model — had its remaining fix designs measured and refused by audit, so this shift shipped README honesty instead of a fourth probe, and filed the one question only Jon can answer: which flagship commissions next.

notes.text: Contra S4 (co-op) claimed and live on slot b — CPU ally seat sim core already pushed. Slot a's warden target was refused and honored, not doubled.

FloorBoss README restructured (#2794): the point-plus-diagonal body model is now recorded as DECIDED state with the audit numbers behind it; the idle ladder stops re-kicking a measured-out wall and reads NONE honestly.
Dry-queue question filed (#2795): R-TYPE vs DOUBLE DRAGON vs 1942 for the next commission — default R-TYPE, and S1 starts if the deadline passes.

Harness lesson inherited: an audit that closes a question must leave a DISCLAIMER marker in the game's README, or the never-dry ladder re-scores the dead design as a gap — that cost three sessions in 48 hours.
